description: Source code for gain quantization functions used in AMR speech codec, including gainQuant_init, gainQuant_reset, gainQuant_exit, and gainQuant, with focus on gain quantization in speech encoding.

methods.name: gainQuant_init
methods.description: Allocates and initializes gainQuantState structure, setting up prediction structures and state variables.

methods.name: gainQuant_reset
methods.description: Resets gainQuantState variables to zero and resets prediction structures.

methods.name: gainQuant_exit
methods.description: Frees memory allocated for gainQuantState and cleans up.

methods.name: gainQuant
methods.description: Performs gain quantization for speech codec, handling different modes and subframes, updating predictor states, and computing quantized gains.
